svy = load("svy")
h = svy.hjs - svy.hjs.mean()          # 평균 중심화
r = svy.refl - svy.refl.mean()
b, se, *_ = ols(svy.mil, [h, r, h * r])
print(b.round(3), se.round(3))
# [4.833 0.987 0.042 0.192] [0.042 0.052 0.031 0.039]

b2, se2, *_ = ols(svy.mil, [svy.hjs, svy.refl, svy.hjs * svy.refl])
print(b2.round(3), se2.round(3))
# [ 4.041  0.12  -0.92   0.192] [0.874 0.177 0.196 0.039]
print(round(np.corrcoef(svy.hjs, svy.hjs * svy.refl)[0, 1], 3),
      round(np.corrcoef(h, h * r)[0, 1], 3))
# 0.641 -0.117

exp = load("exp")                                    # 3장의 실험판 (366명)
k = exp.mil_t1 - exp.mil_t1.mean()                   # 기저 의미만 중심화
bu, _, pu, _ = ols(exp.mil, [exp.cond, exp.mil_t1, exp.cond * exp.mil_t1])
bc, _, pc, _ = ols(exp.mil, [exp.cond, k, exp.cond * k])
print(round(bu[1], 2), round(pu[1], 3), round(bu[3], 2))
print(round(bc[1], 2), round(pc[1], 3), round(bc[3], 2))
# 0.18 0.667 0.02
# 0.29 0.007 0.02

sd = svy.refl.std(ddof=1)
print(round(sd, 3), [float(round(b[1] + b[3] * v, 3)) for v in (-sd, 0, sd)])
# 1.338 [0.731, 0.987, 1.244]

tq = stats.t.ppf(.975, len(svy) - 4)   # 자유도 n − 4의 t 값
for v in (-sd, 0, sd):
    rv = r - v                           # refl의 기준을 v로 옮긴다
    bv, sev, *_ = ols(svy.mil, [h, rv, h * rv])
    print(round(bv[1], 3), round(sev[1], 3),
          round(bv[1] - tq * sev[1], 2), round(bv[1] + tq * sev[1], 2))
# 0.731 0.069 0.59 0.87
# 0.987 0.052 0.88 1.09
# 1.244 0.078 1.09 1.4

xs = np.linspace(h.min(), h.max(), 50)                 # 자료에 있는 hjs 범위 (중심화한 값)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
for v, lab in [(-sd, "회고 습관 −1SD"), (0, "평균"), (sd, "+1SD")]:
    ax.plot(xs + svy.hjs.mean(), b[0] + b[1] * xs + b[2] * v + b[3] * xs * v, label=lab)
ax.set_xlabel("여정 지각 (hjs)")
ax.set_ylabel("삶의 의미 예측값 (mil)")
ax.legend()

med = svy.refl.median()
for lab, sub in [("하위", svy[svy.refl <= med]), ("상위", svy[svy.refl > med])]:
    bs, *_ = ols(sub.mil, [sub.hjs])
    print(lab, len(sub), round(bs[1], 3))
# 하위 435 0.873
# 상위 131 1.438

med, sd, m = svy.refl.median(), svy.refl.std(ddof=1), svy.refl.mean()
for lab, sub in [("하위", svy[svy.refl <= med]), ("상위", svy[svy.refl > med])]:
    print(lab, round((sub.refl.mean() - m) / sd, 2))
# 하위 -0.4
# 상위 1.31

hi = (svy.refl > svy.refl.median()).astype(int)   # 상위 집단이면 1
bg, seg, *_ = ols(svy.mil, [svy.hjs, hi, svy.hjs * hi])
print(bg.round(3), seg.round(3))
# [ 0.494  0.873 -2.883  0.564] [0.281 0.056 0.71  0.135]

fac = load("fac")                                      # 요인판 정제본 430명
g = fac.groupby(["elem", "frame"]).mil_t2
print(g.size().tolist(), g.mean().round(2).tolist(), g.std().round(2).tolist())
b01, *_ = ols(fac.mil_t2, [fac.elem, fac.frame, fac.elem * fac.frame])   # 0/1 부호화
ec, fc = fac.elem - .5, fac.frame - .5                                    # 효과 부호화
bef, seef, *_ = ols(fac.mil_t2, [ec, fc, ec * fc])
print(b01.round(3), bef.round(3), round((bef[1] / seef[1]) ** 2, 2))
# [110, 106, 109, 105] [4.9, 4.81, 4.95, 5.2] [1.3, 1.32, 1.27, 1.26]
# [ 4.902  0.05  -0.093  0.337] [4.965 0.218 0.075 0.337] 3.08

import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
fit = smf.ols("mil_t2 ~ C(elem, Sum) * C(frame, Sum)", data=fac).fit()
rows = ["C(elem, Sum)", "C(frame, Sum)", "C(elem, Sum):C(frame, Sum)"]
for typ in (2, 3):
    print(typ, sm.stats.anova_lm(fit, typ=typ).loc[rows, "F"].round(2).tolist())
# 2 [2.99, 0.36, 1.84]
# 3 [3.08, 0.36, 1.84]

d2 = (svy.gender == 2).astype(int)                     # 여 (기준 = 남)
d3 = (svy.gender == 3).astype(int)                     # 그 외
x = svy.hjs
r2_0 = ols(svy.mil, [x, d2, d3])[3]                    # 곱항 없는 모형
r2_1 = ols(svy.mil, [x, d2, d3, x * d2, x * d3])[3]    # 곱항 둘을 더한 모형
n = len(svy)
F = ((r2_1 - r2_0) / 2) / ((1 - r2_1) / (n - 6))
print(round(r2_1 - r2_0, 4), round(F, 2), round(stats.f.sf(F, 2, n - 6), 3))
for g in (1, 2, 3):
    s = svy[svy.gender == g]
    bg3, seg3, *_ = ols(s.mil, [s.hjs])
    tq = stats.t.ppf(.975, len(s) - 2)
    print(g, len(s), round(bg3[1], 2), round(bg3[1] - tq * seg3[1], 2), round(bg3[1] + tq * seg3[1], 2))
# 0.0001 0.06 0.941
# 1 270 0.97 0.83 1.12
# 2 284 0.99 0.84 1.14
# 3 12 0.89 0.54 1.25
